newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Henry Walker extends gold mine work.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Henry Walker extends gold mine work.

text.p: The Mirrkworlk Joint Venture contract mining group has been awarded an eight-year extension to provide services to the Mount Todd gold mine in the Northern Territory, contract miner Henry Walker Group Ltd said on Tuesday.

Henry Walker holds a 50 percent interest in the joint venture with two Aboriginal groups, the Jawoyn Association and the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Commercial Development Corp, which each own 25 percent.
The contract is worth between A$160 million and A$190 million in total, Henry Walker said.
The contract follows a commitment by the mine's owner, Pegasus Gold Australia Pty Ltd, to a second-stage expansion of the open-cut mine, Henry Walker said.
Under the terms of the new contract, Mirrkworlk will be responsible for delivering ore to the mine's primary crushing system, Henry Walker said.
Mirrkworlk already was under contract at Mount Todd until the end of 1996.
